facts.business: Kandagiri Spinning Mills Limited is engaged in yarn trading business.

The Promoter Directors are infusing funds and assured to contribute additional funds as and when necessary and exploring various possibilities for revival of the Company in the near future.

facts.related_party_note: Related party transactions (which are of repetitive nature including transactions which are exempted under fourth proviso to section 188(1) of Companies Act, 2013 and are duly reviewed by Audit Committee and Board of Directors and does not fall under the purview of disclosure under Form AOC – 2) carried out during the FY 2025-26 by the Company are given in note 33 to the Notes to the Standalone financial statements under Ind AS 24 disclosures. There were no materially significant transactions with Related Parties during the financial year 2025-26 which were in conflict with the interest of the Company. Further, Company is exempted from the provisions of regulation 23 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 which deals with related party transactions.
